projects.name: motion-audit
projects.what: Checks that a website moves the way it should: every button responds when pressed, and nothing stutters.
projects.problem: A site can look fine in a screenshot and still feel broken to use.
projects.role: I built it and published it for other developers to use.
projects.line: It watches the real page in a real browser, frame by frame, and reports what feels wrong.

projects.name: http-attack
projects.what: Attacks your back end the way a hacker would, before a real one does.
projects.problem: Most security holes live in the cases nobody thought to test.
projects.role: I built it and published it for other developers to use.
projects.line: It tries bad input, request floods and other users' accounts, then reports what broke and how serious it is.

projects.name: migrations-safe
projects.what: Tests database changes on a copy before they touch the real one.
projects.problem: One careless change to a database can lose customer data or stop a running business.
projects.role: I built it and published it for other developers to use.
projects.line: It checks the change, then runs it on a copy of the data first, on every major database.
